card.name: The before Medication Guide
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "the" right after "the importance of reading", just before "Medication Guide" in opioid REMS counseling text. It also fires on a few other words, such as "facial" or a comma in a company name.

modes.label: Reading the Medication Guide
modes.description: The word "the" after "importance of reading", leading into "Medication Guide".

modes.label: Stray single words
modes.description: Occasional hits on one word in unrelated label text, such as "facial" before muscle weakness.

modes.label: Comma in company name
modes.description: A comma after a company name before "Inc.".
modes.example: Trademark of Medical Economics Company<<,>> Inc. .
